title: Qatayef with Walnuts: Fried Pancake Half-Moons with Cinnamon Walnut Filling
changes_from_base: a thinner yeasted batter, closed half-moons filled with cinnamon walnuts and raisins, deep-fried at 175 °C and dipped in warm syrup instead of left half-open with cream
summary: Yeasted pancakes stuffed with cinnamon walnuts and golden raisins, sealed into half-moons, fried and dipped in warm syrup.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
neutral frying oil (sunflower, rapeseed or vegetable)

steps.title: Start the batter
steps.text: Stir the flour, semolina, sugar, yeast and salt together, then whisk in the warm water until no lumps remain. Leave covered for 1-1.5 h; it is ready once frothy and a thin layer of liquid has gathered at the edge, showing the yeast is active.

steps.title: Prepare the syrup
steps.text: Bring the sugar and 120 ml water to a simmer and cook for 8 min, until a spoon dipped in it comes out lightly glazed. Off the heat, add the lemon juice and orange blossom water if using; set it over the lowest flame so it stays warm.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Combine the walnuts, raisins, sugar, cinnamon and the tablespoon of orange blossom water or water. Press a little together; it should just clump, which keeps it neat inside the pancakes.

steps.title: Make 12 pancakes
steps.text: Just before cooking, whisk in the bicarbonate. Use a dry non-stick pan over medium-low heat and add 2 tbsp of batter at a time, letting each spread to roughly 10 cm. Leave them unturned for 1-2 min until the surface has set with lots of small holes and the underside is golden, then stack under a tea towel.

steps.title: Shape the half-moons
steps.text: Put roughly 20 g of the walnut mix on the bubbly side of each pancake, fold over and press the edges together hard before crimping with a fork. Any gap lets oil in and the filling out.

steps.title: Fry in batches
steps.text: Bring 4 cm of oil to 175 °C. Cook 3-4 pieces at once for around 2 min, flipping halfway, until crisp and a deep golden brown; small batches keep the temperature steady and the pastry dry.

steps.title: Soak briefly
steps.text: Let them drip for a moment on the rack, then turn each in the warm syrup for 30 s. Serve warm or at room temperature.

tips: Chop the walnuts finely so the filling packs well and does not tear the pancakes.
A common mistake is crimping a pancake that has dried out. Keep them covered and they fold without cracking.
Toast the walnuts lightly first for a deeper flavour if you have time.
They are good warm or at room temperature.
safety: Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days. Warm in a 180 °C (160 °C fan) oven for 5-8 min to crisp them again.
